name: Unit dots
oneLiner: a glass board of 100 beads stands on a lit floor, N of them light up in the accent from the bottom row like a rising level while the big number counts with them and the camera rides the level, the last bead lands with a ring and the lit group pulses
say: when the speaker gives a share as 'N out of 100' or a percent ('37 out of 100 creators never post twice'): cut in on the stat, the last bead lands on the number word
